cues: Genial Unitarian-essayist irony defending the 'obviousness' of Dickens against latter-day critics (matches Crothers' essay 'The Obviousness of Dickens'); editorial 'we', scriptural echo ('a soft answer turneth away wrath'), homely American simile of a one-price clothing store, Pecksniff/Cheeryble/Sam Weller examples.
